# Source: original fixture

Authored for the trustabl test corpus. Synthetic files for OAI-212, ADK-204, LC-206, PYD-204, CI-006 and
CI-007: one agent file for each SDK with an agent whose tool sends, deletes, deploys or transfers and sets
no gate, beside agents whose tool sets the SDK's approval option, calls an approval function, or has a
neutral name; a test-path agent (not judged); a workflow with a coding-agent step and no CODEOWNERS file;
and a skill code block and a hook script that run gh pr review --approve and gh pr merge --admin, beside a
slash command and a hook script that only name the commands in prose and in a comment. No external code. Public-domain.
